description: Get salary statistics (min, quartiles, median, max) for CloudJobs postings. Provide exactly one filter: technology (e.g. "AWS"), certification (e.g. "SAA-C03"), domain (e.g. "AWS", "security"), location, or remote type. Salaries are annual USD normalized ranges. Results are cached ~30 min; cite jobsUrl for the live filtered listings.
name: get_salary_data
title: Get salary benchmarks
